descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name קֵינָן (Qeynan/Qenan), a descendant of Seth listed in the genealogies of Genesis 5 and 1 Chronicles 1. The two clusters reflect minor transliteration variation (Qeynan vs. Qenan) across target languages but denote the same individual. Eng 'Qeynan/Qenan,' Spa 'Quenán/Quenan,' Hin 'कēनान/केनान,' Arb 'قِينَانَ/قِينان,' Kor '게난,' Swa 'Kenani.' No semantic distinction exists between the two forms.
